scope: Developer-Aesthetics light theme overhaul without Tailwind/Shadcn, dark mode, or Vue/Vite migration.
changedFiles: all HTML pages: added v52 aesthetics stylesheet link and versioned assets
visualChanges: Added shared design tokens for developer-aesthetic light theme.
Softened header, search, quick access, featured tools, directory, and card shadows.
Removed visible featured-card color rails via v52 override; cards now use white bento surfaces, subtle border, and ambient shadow.
Restyled tool workbench to remove outer box-in-box effect and make input/output panels the primary surface.
Restyled textareas as lightweight code editors with monospace font and faux gutter.
Restyled action bars: dark primary, white secondary, danger hover only for clear-like last action.
Restyled generator/hash result rows as compact light monospace rows with hover copy buttons instead of dark blocks.
Kept all pages on static Vue CDN architecture; no heavyweight editor library loaded.
